fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the structural and thermal performance of precast concrete products.

fields.name: layer_thickness
fields.rationale: Layer thickness is important for understanding the application and structural capacity of the concrete product.

fields.name: suitable_for_load_bearing
fields.rationale: Indicates whether the product can be used for load-bearing applications, which is critical for structural design.
evidence: suitable for the construction of above-ground and below-ground load-bearing or non-load-bearing interior and exterior walls
inference_basis: Mention of suitability for load-bearing walls suggests this property.
